title: The six /for doors, /spaces/new, /offer and /rewards are in the visual and accessibility surface list
detail:
None of these launch-path routes appear in the surface registry and there is no Playwright journey for the try-first funnel.

The six /for doors, /join, /accessibility and /help join the public surface list (LAUNCH_DOOR_PATHS in test/e2e/surfaces.ts), so the a11y ratchet holds them at zero by default; /spaces/new, /offer and /rewards need a session and are named in LAUNCH_SESSION_ROUTES. test/e2e/funnel.spec.ts walks each door and the signed-out hop through /sign-in for /spaces/new and /offer. Visual baselines for the new surfaces are captured by the next update_baselines dispatch.

verify.note: Exits 0 only when the repair has landed; fails on main today.
